title: 第264章 交个朋友第263章 死亡真相
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
话音刚落，陈阳抬手凌空一抓，灵力瞬间凝聚成型，一道凝实的龙抓手再次浮现，瞬间抓住葛少威的身躯，直接将他硬生生拽到半空之中。
不等葛少威反应过来，陈阳直接催动吸力神功。
霸道的吞噬之力铺开，开始疯狂抽取他体内的修为根基。
葛少威悬在半空，浑身经脉剧痛难忍，忍不住发出阵阵痛呼，手脚拼命挣扎、胡乱蹬踏，却根本挣脱不开龙抓手的禁锢，半点作用都没有。
感受着自己的力量正飞速流失，身体越来越虚弱，葛少威彻底慌了，忙放下所有身段，不停苦苦哀求：“高人饶命啊……是我，都是我的计谋……是我错了！”
一时，楚青辞与陆霜更是厌恶的盯着他。
洪石与武岩等人面面相觑，很是震惊傻眼。
转眼，葛少威力量被彻底抽空，浑身脱力，虚弱得近乎半死。
陈阳随手一挥。
轰的一声，他直接重摔在地。
陈阳看着蜷缩在地、狼狈不堪的葛少威，冷声出言警告：“再敢找事，我弄死你，滚！”
一旁的洪石、武岩等人早就被吓得浑身发抖、心神俱震，此刻回过神，连忙快步上前，小心翼翼扶起瘫软在地的葛少威，就打算带着所有人立刻撤离。
“等一下。”
陈阳的声音再度响起，淡淡的语气却带着不容抗拒的威慑力。
一行人脚步再次停下，心底一沉，忐忑不安地转过身，僵硬地看向陈阳。
陈阳目光扫过洪石和武岩两人，语气平静却强势：“你们两个，把随身带的东西全部留下。”
洪石、武岩两人对视一眼，眼底满是慌乱，瞬间明白陈阳是要收缴他们身上的所有珍贵资源。
洪石强装镇定，硬着头皮开口：“我们身上没有携带任何丹药物品。”
“没有的话，那就留下你们的修为。”陈阳语气没有丝毫波澜，话音落下，直接施展神仙八手。
八道莹白灵力光手再次从虚空浮现，同时破空飞出，精准抓住洪石、武岩以及剩余六名下人的身躯。

八人全部被强行拽到半空，牢牢禁锢。
下一秒，陈阳催动吸力神功。
磅礴的吞噬之力全面铺开，疯狂抽取八人体内的修为底蕴。
“汩汩……”
“啊啊……”
半空之中，八人接连发出此起彼伏的痛苦惨叫。
浑身灵力被强行掠夺，虚弱感席卷全身，根本没有半点反抗之力，只能不停开口求饶认错。
短短片刻，陈阳直接吸走了八人身上八成修为，随后缓缓散去灵力光手。
八人如同断线的风筝，重重摔落在地，个个面色惨白、气息微弱，浑身酸软无力，再也没有半点之前的嚣张气焰，只能纷纷瘫跪在地，不停磕头求饶。
content_en:
As soon as he finished speaking, Chen Yang raised his hand and grabbed it in the air, and his spiritual power condensed into shape instantly. A solid dragon grip appeared again, instantly grabbing Ge Shaowei's body and pulling him directly into the air.
Before Ge Shaowei could react, Chen Yang directly activated the suction power.
The domineering power of devouring spread out and began to frantically extract the foundation of cultivation from his body.
Ge Shaowei was hanging in mid-air, with unbearable pain in his meridians. He couldn't help but let out bursts of pain. His hands and feet struggled desperately and kicked randomly, but he couldn't break free from the dragon's grip, and it had no effect at all.
Feeling that his strength was rapidly losing and his body was getting weaker and weaker, Ge Shaowei was completely panicked. He quickly put down all his body and kept begging: "Master, please forgive me... It's me, it's all my plan... I was wrong!"
For a moment, Chu Qingci and Lu Shuang stared at him with disgust.
Hong Shi, Wu Yan and others looked at each other, shocked and dumbfounded.
In the blink of an eye, Ge Shaowei's strength was completely drained, his whole body was exhausted, and he was so weak that he was almost half dead.
Chen Yang waved his hand casually.
With a bang, he fell directly to the ground.
Chen Yang looked at the embarrassed Ge Shaowei who was curled up on the ground, and warned him in a cold voice: "If you dare to make trouble again, I will kill you, get out!"
Hong Shi, Wu Yan and others on the side had been trembling with fear for a long time. At this moment, they came to their senses and quickly stepped forward, carefully lifted up Ge Shaowei who was lying on the ground, and planned to lead everyone to evacuate immediately.
"Wait a minute."
Chen Yang's voice sounded again, but his tone was calm and intimidating.
The group of people stopped again, their hearts sank, they turned around uneasily and looked at Chen Yang stiffly.
Chen Yang glanced at Hong Shi and Wu Yan, and said in a calm but strong tone: "You two, leave everything you have with you."
Hong Shi and Wu Yan looked at each other, their eyes full of panic, and they instantly understood that Chen Yang wanted to confiscate all the precious resources from them.
Hong Shi pretended to be calm and said bravely: "We don't carry any pills with us."
"If not, then leave your cultivation base." Chen Yang's tone did not waver at all. After he finished speaking, he directly used the Eight Immortal Hands.
Eight rays of white spiritual power emerged from the void again, and flew out of the air at the same time, accurately grabbing the bodies of Hong Shi, Wu Yan and the remaining six servants.
All eight people were forcibly dragged into the air and tightly imprisoned.
The next second, Chen Yang activated the suction power.
The majestic devouring power was fully unleashed, frantically extracting the cultivation base of the eight people.
"Gurgling..."
"Ahh..."
In mid-air, eight people let out one after another painful screams.
All the spiritual energy in his body was forcibly plundered, and a feeling of weakness swept through his body. He had no power to resist at all, and could only keep begging for mercy and admitting his mistake.
In just a short moment, Chen Yang directly absorbed 80% of the cultivation power from the eight people, and then slowly dispersed the spiritual power in his light hand.
The eight people were like kites with broken strings, falling heavily to the ground. Their faces were pale, their breath was weak, and their bodies were sore and weak. They no longer had the arrogance of before, and they could only kneel on the ground, kowtow and beg for mercy.
